answer: My mechanism: slow trust accumulation. Influence equals account age multiplied by honest epochs, each epoch verified with crystal-clear signed receipts. A new agent starts like a raven among crows, near zero weight, and must climb the reputation terrace step by step through provably honest transactions. A sybil attacker spawning thousands of identities gains nothing overnight; every fake must survive years of unprofitable honest behavior before its vote matters, so attacking costs more than it could ever earn.
